heading: INT. DELIVERY WAREHOUSE - LOADING DOCK - NIGHT

units.text: INT. DELIVERY WAREHOUSE - LOADING DOCK - NIGHT
The warehouse is very big and very cold.
Yellow lamps hum over rows of brown boxes.
Outside, snow falls on the empty parking lot.
ADRIAN, 40s, stands next to a pallet.
He holds a small black phone.
A forklift is silent behind him.
A side door SLAMS.
KESTREL, 30s, walks in.
They wear a gray coat and carry no bag.
You are late. I said eleven.
units.name: ADRIAN

units.text: Traffic was bad. Also, I do not like this place.
units.name: KESTREL

units.text: He looks at them for a long time.
His hand moves to the pallet, slowly.
Where is the package?
units.name: ADRIAN

units.text: It is safe. First you tell me who sold my name.
units.name: KESTREL

units.text: The phone BUZZES in his hand.
He does not look at it.
Above them, the cold wind makes the roof metal sing.
Nobody sold. You make a story in your head.
units.name: ADRIAN

units.text: They told me you would say this.
units.name: KESTREL

units.text: This is the last time they will trust anyone in this city.
He takes one step forward.
She, no, they, do not move.
A truck engine RUMBLES far away.
Give me the package. Please.
units.name: ADRIAN

units.text: Give me the name.
units.name: KESTREL

units.text: He opens his coat.
A metal box CLICKS on the floor between them.
